summary: Track hub file links to a folder that does not exist
detail: All 96 bigDataUrl links point to DLPFC/ATACseq/bw/, but DLPFC/ holds only RNAseq/README.md (126 bytes). trackDB_PFC.txt in the same folder lists the same tracks and every link resolves: use that one.
evidence: Each bigDataUrl key compared with the catalog (listing): 0 of 96 exist under DLPFC/; trackDB_PFC.txt 96 of 96 exist; the two files differ only in the folder name.

summary: ATAC release 2024-12-06 is not described in its changelog
detail: Files are dated 2024-12-06, but MTG/ATACseq/Changelog.html documents only Update 1 (2024-02-13: real ages over 90, full APOE genotypes, Severely Affected Donor, per-donor objects). Whatever changed in December 2024 is undocumented.
evidence: Changelog.html read in full (exported notebook; one dated update).

summary: ATAC subclass names differ from the 2026 RNA release
detail: The 2024 ATAC objects use older subclass names (seen: Microglia-PVM, VLMC) where the 2026 RNA objects use Immune and VLMC & Perivascular. Joining ATAC and RNA on Subclass by name silently drops these cells; map the names first.
evidence: Subclass levels in inspect reports: MTG ATAC all-nuclei metadata CSV (2024-12-06, 1,123,761 nuclei, 24 subclasses incl. Microglia-PVM, VLMC) and MTG ATAC per-donor H21.33.034, vs LEC RNA per-donor H20.33.036 (2026-06-22: Immune, VLMC & Perivascular).

summary: Severely Affected Donor: 'N' can mean 'not marked Y'; blanks differ between files
detail: The changelog notebook fills blanks with 'N' (fillna) when adding Severely Affected Donor to the h5ad objects, so donors with no entry are coded N there. The all-nuclei metadata CSV was not filled the same way: 18,883 of its rows have no value.
evidence: MTG/ATACseq/Changelog.html (Update 1 code cell); inspect report of SEAAD_MTG_ATACseq_all-nuclei_metadata.2024-12-06.csv.

summary: Missing values stored as the text 'nan' in obs categories
detail: Some obs columns (e.g. specify other race, Secondary Study Name) hold the word 'nan' as a category instead of a missing value. pandas and scanpy show it as a real category called 'nan'; treat it as missing.
evidence: inspect reports of LEC RNA per-donor H20.33.036 (2026-06-22) and MTG ATAC per-donor H21.33.034 (2024-12-06).

summary: Read-count columns are entirely empty in RNA metadata
detail: Number of reads, Number of mapped/unmapped/multimapped reads, GEX_number_of_reads and GEX_sequencing_saturation have no values in any row. Use GEX_Mean_raw_reads_per_cell and GEX_Sequenced_read_pairs (per library) for depth.
evidence: inspect report of SEAAD_LEC_RNAseq_final-nuclei_metadata.2026-06-22.csv (182260 rows); other regions not yet checked.

summary: Website lists snATAC-seq for ten regions; the open bucket has two
detail: brain-map.org/consortia/sea-ad/our-data says processed snATAC-seq is available for ten regions as of November 2026. A live listing of the bucket finds ATACseq/ folders only under MTG/ and PFC/ (2024-12-06 release). The other regions may be elsewhere, unreleased, or the page may be ahead of the bucket.
evidence: Live listing of every top-level folder in sea-ad-single-cell-profiling on 2026-11-22; page text read the same day.

summary: Brain Region is written 'Human MTG' / 'Human MTG All Layers' in ATAC metadata
detail: The 2024 ATAC metadata uses two Brain Region labels, 'Human MTG' and 'Human MTG All Layers', where the 2026 RNA files use the code (e.g. LEC). Filtering on Brain Region == 'MTG' finds nothing; filter on the folder or the label actually present.

summary: MERFISH max-projection images carry no pixel size, and no transform file is published
detail: The DAPI/PolyT/Aux1 max-projection TIFFs (64-bit float, uncompressed, one plane) have no physical pixel size in their header, and the folders hold only the three images and cellpose-detected_transcripts.csv: no micron-to-pixel transform. Overlaying transcripts on the images needs the scale from another source.
evidence: peek of DAPI_Max.tif header in this folder (2026-11-22) and a listing of the folder; no key containing 'transform' anywhere in the bucket catalog. Only this folder's header was checked; the other 158 max-projection images are probably alike but unverified.

summary: Sheet named 'VIC-ESOC' (letter I) where the region code is V1C (digit 1)
detail: In the quantitative neuropathology workbook the V1C/ESOC sheet is called 'VIC-ESOC'; its brain region column says V1C and ESOC. Code that selects the sheet by region code ('V1C-ESOC') will not find it.
evidence: inspect report of sea-ad-quantitative-neuropathology-063026.xlsx (sheet names; brain region levels).
